narrationTexts: Fix both: `resolveRetries` reads `options.retries` but callers now pass `retryCount`, and `isBackoffEnabled` throws on `undefined` instead of treating it as disabled.
finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs, both in the link stage:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. Fixed to match.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw when a flag was `undefined` instead of `false`. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, so it crashed every build. Now treats anything but `true` as disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise (`Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `punycode`, etc), harmless.

Next: consider silencing `punycode`/`Buffer()` warnings upstream if they keep cluttering CI logs.
